title: How to Calculate Age from Date of Birth
description: Learn to calculate calendar age in years, months and days, with birthday examples, month-end rules and a clear explanation of the today-only calculator.
summary: Count completed calendar years and months, then the remaining days. Understand why days divided by 365 is not calendar age.

title: How to Calculate Volume: Five Common 3D Shapes
description: Choose the volume formula for a cube, rectangular prism, cylinder, sphere or cone. Follow worked examples and avoid radius, height and cubic-unit mistakes.
summary: Choose the right measurements and formula for five solids, then check cubic units, rounding and container assumptions.

title: How to Calculate a Restaurant Tip and Total Bill
description: Calculate a restaurant tip and total using an itemized bill. Understand the chosen tip base, tax, service charges and rounding with a worked $48 example.
summary: Separate the amount you tip on from tax and service charges, and avoid adding charges twice when finding the final bill.

title: Percentage Increase and Decrease: Formula and Common Mistakes
description: Calculate percentage change from old and new values. See why increases and decreases do not cancel, how percentage points differ, and when zero is invalid.
summary: Choose the correct baseline, interpret the sign and distinguish percentage changes from percentage points.

title: Days Between Dates: Elapsed Days vs Inclusive Counting
description: Compare elapsed days with inclusive date counting using same-day, reversed-date and leap-year examples. Learn what the date calculator does and does not count.
summary: Decide whether you need the gaps between dates or every calendar date in an interval, including both endpoints.

title: Leap-Year Birthdays and Month-End Age Calculations
description: Understand February 29 birthdays and month-end age calculations with worked calendar examples, anchored anniversaries and clear limits on legal interpretations.
summary: Compare leap-day and month-end boundaries using an explicit anniversary rule, and understand why calendar-age tools can disagree.

title: Cylinder, Cone and Sphere Volume: Compare Like for Like
description: Compare cylinder, cone and sphere volumes with equal radii and heights. Verify the 3:2:1 ratio, equal-volume dimensions and common diameter mistakes.
summary: Hold dimensions constant, compare ideal capacities and see exactly when the cylinder, sphere and cone ratio is 3:2:1.

title: Calculate 15%, 18% and 20% Tips Without a Calculator
description: Work out 15%, 18% and 20% tips mentally using 10% and 1%. Check bill totals, cent rounding and equal splits with practical receipt examples.
summary: Build common tip percentages from simple fractions, check the final bill and handle rounding when sharing a total.

title: How EMI Is Calculated: Formula, Interest and Repayment
description: Understand the reducing-balance EMI formula with a 12-month loan example, principal and interest breakdown, term comparison and practical limitations.
summary: Follow a loan payment from the EMI formula to its interest and principal portions, and compare monthly payments with total borrowing cost.

title: Compound Interest with Regular Deposits: Worked Examples
description: Calculate compound interest with monthly deposits. Follow verified examples, compare deposit timing and understand compounding frequency and fractional years.
summary: Separate contributions from growth, compare deposit timing and reproduce a monthly savings projection with clear assumptions.
